activity_summary: You began the first of the leaves. No name, no number, no person at the head. You dated it the twenty-seventh of January, 1594, because the legal year has not turned. You stopped before it could belong to anyone.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the leaf and left it unfinished.

entities.name: the inkhorn
entities.context: Mentioned in No name at the head

facets.activity: Began a leaf and dated it in the old year
